idea-plugin.name: Vitesse Islands
idea-plugin.description:
The calm, low-contrast Vitesse palette, rebuilt for the new Islands UI.

Two variants are included:

  • Vitesse Dark Islands: deep #121212 background, muted and easy on the eyes.
  • Vitesse Soft Islands: softer #222 background with livelier, more saturated colors.

What's different from a straight port

  • UI themes inherit from Islands Dark, so islands, rounded corners and spacing stay native. Cool blue-greys are replaced by Vitesse's warm neutral greys and cream text; the blue accent becomes Vitesse green.
  • Full C# / Rider coverage through ReSharper highlighting keys: declaration keywords and control flow get separate colors, records, structs, interfaces, properties, fields, events and constants are all distinct.
  • Bold keywords and italic types, methods and properties make code structure easy to scan.
  • Hues are tuned so neighbouring token kinds never blend: classes, structs, interfaces, methods and numbers each get their own color.
  • JS/TS, JSON, XML, YAML, diffs, search results, console and debugger colors follow the same palette.

Requires an IDE version 2025.3 or newer (Islands UI).

Palette based on Vitesse by Anthony Fu (MIT). UI and editor base derived from JetBrains Islands Dark and Rider Islands Dark (Apache-2.0). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Vitesse author or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0: first public release.

  • Vitesse Dark Islands and Vitesse Soft Islands UI themes with matching editor color schemes.
  • C#/Rider highlighting with bold keywords, italic types and members, distinct hues per token kind.
